parameters.name: DataSourceId
parameters.description: The data source ID. You can call the [ListParserDataSource](~~432676~~) operation to query the list of data sources and obtain the **DataSourceId**.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If your instance has an ID, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If the **Overview** page or ID is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).
